name: A Cat With Its Own Will

game.core.world.fact.summary: Ganji has a natural affinity for cats. A planned future story hook: he may cross paths with a cat of unusual, independent will that can understand him -- a possible companion, given his affinity, playable as a small optional thread rather than a major plot point.
game.core.world.fact.provenance: GM worldbuilding note, from player-provided character background
